title: Next.js: HttpOnly cookie exposure through internal response header on Next.js Edge runtime routes (CVE-2026-119346)
description: Next.js versions from 15.0.0 up to but not including 15.5.29, and from 16.0.0 up to but not including 16.4.5, have a vulnerability where HttpOnly cookies set via NextResponse on Edge runtime routes are exposed through an internal response header. This header duplicates the cookie value and attributes, making sensitive HttpOnly cookies accessible to JavaScript on the same origin. This issue affects App Router route handlers and Pages Router Edge API routes. A fix is available in versions 15.5.29 and 16.4.5.
